title: Entrance Antiphon LR 184
author: Cf. Psalm 17:6, 8
snippet: To you I call, for you will surely heed me, O God; turn your ear to me; hear my words. Guard me as the apple of your eye; in the shadow of your wings protect me.

title: (Psalm 96: 1, 3, 4-5, 7-8, 9-10)
author: Francesca LaRosa
snippet: Give the Lord glory and honor.

title: Gospel Acclamation 29th Sunday (A)
author: Philippians 2:15d, 16a
snippet: Shine like lights in the world as you hold on to the word of life.

title: Shelter Me, O God
author: Bob Hurd
snippet: Shelter me, O God, hide me in the shadow of your wings. You alone are my hope.

title: Communion Antiphon LR 185
author: Cf. Psalm 33 (32):18-19
snippet: Behold, the eyes of the Lord are on those who fear him, who hope in his merciful love, to rescue their souls from death, to keep the alive in famine.

title: Exposition/O Saving Victim
author: Curtis Stephan/Steve Angrisano
snippet: O King Exalted, savior of nations, we lift our eyes to heaven’s throne. Hear us, Redeemer, show us your mercy; we place our trust in you alone.

title: Restless
author: Audrey Assad
snippet: You dwell in the songs that we are singing, rising to the heavens, rising to your heart, your heart. Our praises filling up the spaces in between our frailty and everything you are.

title: Forever
author: Chris Tomlin
snippet: Give thanks to the Lord, our God and King; his love endures forever. For he is good, he is above all things; his love endures forever; Sing praise, sing praise!

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
